Ak'Anon Vendors

Listed here are the Ak'Anon vendors. All the spell vendors in Ak'Anon are named Clockwork Merchants so I could not as easily list them all by name and the spells they carry. Instead I inventoried them from left to right of the room that they were in. I will meerly name the Clockwork Merchant 1, Clockwork Merchant 2 etc. As you come up the ramp to the spellcasters guildhall, you will see to your left a   Clock work Merchant. This merchant sells all of the Enchanter Illusions (Illusion: Human, Illusion: Erudite etc). Then once you enter the actual guild hall, immediately to your left will be the Magician vendors. The door right next to that room also contain one Magician vendor. Right next to that room is a Wizard room, but no spells are sold there. Next to that door is a open room with the Wizard vendors. Next to that room is another door leading back out into the city of Ak'Anon. Then next to that door is the Enchanter vendors.
